full_judgment: 22. It is therefore held that the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court is affirmed in the modified form and the suit is decreed in full and both the appeals are dismissed. Defendants are directed to deliver khas possession of 1.48 acres of land as mentioned to the schedule of the plaint within 60 (sixty) days from the date of this judgment failing which plaintiffs shall get khas possession of the same through Court in accordance with law.
